source:
This is a major update to Soundscape.

Travel mode is much improved. When you travel by car or bus, Soundscape now calls out road numbers, your direction of travel, and nearby settlements. It also calls out when you cross rivers, canals, firths, and bays. Please update your offline maps to get these new features. Bus stop descriptions are now much better for users in the UK.

Sleep mode can now wake automatically when it detects that you are moving again. You no longer need to remember to wake it yourself.

We reorganized the underlying code so that we can build an iOS app from the same code. This means that in the future, we can release an iOS app with all of the features we have built for Android.

Please continue to report any problems, however small, through Contact Support in the main menu.

source:
Soundscape provides several ways to control what you hear and when:

1. Immediately stop all audio: Double tap the screen with two fingers to immediately turn off all audio, including any callout that is currently playing and the beacon if it is on. Callouts will resume automatically when you approach the next intersection or point of interest, but the audible beacon will not. Select the *unmute beacon button* on the main screen to resume hearing the beacon.

2. Stop automatic callouts: When you are not traveling or have reached a destination, you probably will not need Soundscape to continue to notify you of things around you. Instead of exiting the app, you can put Soundscape into Snooze Mode and it will wake up again when you leave, or you can put Soundscape into Sleep Mode and it will stay off until you turn it back on. Alternatively, you can select *Settings* from the menu and set *Callout Detail* to *Silent* in the *Manage Callouts* section.

3. Stop the beacon: There are several scenarios where you might set a destination but not need the audible beacon on. For example, you may know exactly how to get to your destination but still want automatic updates about how far away you are. Or you might only need the audio beacon as you near your destination. Whatever the case, you can choose when to hear the beacon by toggling the *mute beacon*/*unmute beacon* button on the main screen.

If you still want to interact with Soundscape but don’t want to hear automatic callouts, you can set *Callout Detail* to *Silent* in the *Manage Callouts* section of the *Settings* screen from the menu. Or, if you aren’t going to be using Soundscape, you can put it in either Sleep or Snooze Mode using the *Sleep* button on the home screen.

Soundscape pakub mitmeid võimalusi, kuidas kontrollida, mida ja millal kuulete:

1. Kogu heli koheseks peatamiseks: puudutage ekraani kahe sõrmega korraga, et koheselt välja lülitada kogu heli, sealhulgas praegu esitatav häälteade ja helimajakas, kui see on sisse lülitatud. Häälteated jätkuvad automaatselt, kui lähenete järgmisele ristmikule või huvipunktile, kuid kuuldav helimajakas mitte. Helimajaka uuesti kuulmiseks valige põhikuval *helimajaka vaigistuse tühistamise nupp*.

2. Automaatsete häälteadete peatamine: kui te ei liigu või olete jõudnud sihtkohta, ei ole teil tõenäoliselt vaja, et Soundscape jätkaks teavitamist ümbritsevatest asjadest. Rakendusest väljumise asemel saate lülitada Soundscape'i uinakurežiimi, mis ärkab uuesti, kui lahkute, või lülitada Soundscape'i unerežiimi, mis jääb väljalülitatuks, kuni selle uuesti sisse lülitate. Teise võimalusena saate menüüst valida *Seadistused* ja seada jaotises *Halda häälteateid* valiku *Häälteadete detailsus* väärtusele *Hääletu*.

3. Helimajaka peatamine: on mitmeid olukordi, kus võite seada sihtkoha, kuid ei vaja kuuldavat helimajakat sisselülitatuna. Näiteks võite täpselt teada, kuidas oma sihtkohta jõuda, kuid soovite siiski automaatseid värskendusi selle kohta, kui kaugel olete. Või vajate helimajakat ainult siis, kui sihtkohale lähenete. Igal juhul saate valida, millal helimajakat kuulete, lülitades põhikuval nuppu *vaigista helimajakas*/*tühista helimajaka vaigistus*.

Kui soovite Soundscape'iga siiski suhelda, kuid ei soovi kuulda automaatseid häälteateid, saate menüüst ekraani *Seadistused* jaotises *Halda häälteateid* seada valiku *Häälteadete detailsus* väärtusele *Hääletu*. Või kui te ei kavatse Soundscape'i kasutada, saate selle lülitada kas unerežiimi või uinakurežiimi, kasutades avakuval nuppu *Unerežiim*.

You can ask Soundscape to:

Describe *My Location*, what is *Around Me*, or what is *Ahead of Me*.

Call out the saved markers near you.

Start one of your saved routes by name, move on to the next waypoint, go back to the previous one, mute the beacon, or stop the route.

Set an audio beacon on one of your saved markers by name, or switch the beacon off.

Set the callout detail to *Silent*, *Essential*, *Simplified* or *Detailed*, to change how much Soundscape says as you walk. *Silent* turns automatic callouts off.

Read back the names of your saved routes or your saved markers.

C5: «Majakas» for a physical navigation beacon collides with the app's own audio beacon, which is «helimajakas» and often shortened to «majakas» (Siri names, tutorial, callouts_audio_beacon_distance). A callout «Majakas» could be heard as the audio beacon. «Signaalmajakas» or «Navigatsioonimajakas» may be clearer; needs a native call.

A clock-face direction is usually «kella kolme suunas», which needs the genitive hour words in relative_clock_hour_1…12 («ühe», «kahe», «kolme»…) as well, changed together with this template.
